scope: Retrospective same-batch anonymous seven-class source-feature search on real uploaded spectra

selection.ranking: eligible selection macroF1; within .002 ties prefer accuracy, fewer selected features, fewer PCA components, smaller C, candidate ID
selection.gate: same criteria relative to reference; failure reverts reference
selection.family_diagnostics: best selection-stage candidate for each of seven families; locked before final

preprocessing.MSC: source mean reference only; per-row intercept/slope correction; fail if abs slope<1e-10, record source slope min/max/negative count
preprocessing.StandardScaler: fit source only after scatter transform

selectors.CARS: 16 MC runs; standardized onehot OVR PLS1 coefficient norms; .8 class-stratified subsampling; exponential elimination to10min; weighted resampling; best source internal onehot PLS MSE; not exact MATLAB
selectors.CARS_internalCV: 3fold anchored: classes with fewer3source samples stay every train, never validation; source-query seven-class outer evaluation unchanged; inner MSE subset diagnostic only
selectors.MCUVE: 30 runs,3PLScomponents,.8 fraction; absolute onehot coefficient stability; top20/50/100
selectors.noise_UVE: 30runs; unit-SD independent Gaussian source noise same dimension as real; absolute onehot coefficient stability, noise .95/.99 quantiles; if empty choose largest stability real1 and record fallback
selectors.SPA: one deterministic successive orthogonal projection chain, largest source pre-scaling variance initial variable; centered source standardized projections, max50 or n-1, rank floor1e-12 relative squared norm; not full multistart SPA
selectors.LDA: lsqr auto shrinkage with uniform/empirical priors; classification, no low-dimensional transform claim
selectors.PCA_LDA: source randomized PCA10/20/40 then same LDA; random seed recorded

fit_policy.candidate_failure_policy: fail fast, preserve actual exception in execution log; do not silently delete/relabel a failed candidate

final.global_release: outputs/image-guided-20261031/all_development_locks.json required and feature lock/protocol/manifest SHA checked

checkpoint_revision.reason: PCA numpy-view layout changes joblib object hash on serialization while values and inference remain unchanged
checkpoint_revision.saved_object_fingerprint: dump, reload, assert source scores and argmax unchanged; fingerprint canonical loaded model
